guideline: Annotators identified sentences containing verifiable factual claims defined as statements that can be objectively verified as true or false based on empirical evidence or reality

## Overview You will be given a set of question -answer pairs . The answers were generated by an LLM , based on some search results . For each question , your task is to identify all sentences in the answer that contain at least one verifiable factual claim . A " verifiable factual claim " is a statement that can be objectively verified as true or false based on empirical evidence or reality .
criteria: presence of speculation, opinion, interpretation, advice

overall_notes: This paper focuses on claim extraction and evaluation for fact-checking of LLM-generated content. The human evaluation was primarily for creating ground truth labels (sentence-level verifiability) rather than evaluating the quality of extracted claims. The paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation framework with automated metrics for claim extraction systems.
